clips.title: The story
paras: At Fire Scar Shrine, fel corruption scars the forest southwest of Astranaar. Once a night elf place of worship, the shrine now draws demons to its altar stones.

Fire Scar Shrine lies southwest of Astranaar and west of the Ruins of Stardust. Demonic corruption has seized the shrine, fed by servants of the Cult of the Dark Strand and the Shadow Council. Fel magic has scorched the earth around it, and demons gather openly among the trees, defying the forest's defenders.

Agents of the Cult of the Dark Strand and the Shadow Council brought corruption to Fire Scar Shrine. The orc warlock Ilkrud Magthrull acted under Athrikus Narassin's orders. Summoned fiends now patrol the altar stones unchecked. A tear in the veil sometimes draws greater horrors, including the towering doomguard Akkrilus.
